title: Synthesis --- Reading the Window
label: ch:synthesis-se
canDo: I can read impersonal signs and ask my way past the words I do not have.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C52-sintesis-el-letrero: read the signs, ask for an unknown word, and say what the missing person buys a notice.
payoff.note: This construction is written at the reader rather than spoken to them, so the skill is reading it off the world -- and the missing person is what gives a sign its authority.
